correctness.rationale: Checked use of Stankovic Theorem 1.1: every fixed singular value converges to eigenvalue modulus and finite-product majorization supplies x_k^(n)<=G_k(s(T)). Taking r=p/2, AM-GM gives G^r<=Hardy(y^r), and dyadic Hardy at exponent 1/2 maps ell_(p,q) into itself for every finite q, with little-weak vanishing tail. Dominated convergence of reordered absolute errors yields ell_(p,q) strong convergence; fixed-prefix/tail handles little weak. For W e_j=(j+1)^(-1/p)e_(j+1), binomial log average gives unchanged far-tail weak norm 1 yet decaying first weight. Independent shift probes at n=0,3,20,80 verified operator-norm decrease and tail tending to weak constant 1; examined CHECK.py. Does not claim operator-level ideal convergence.
